flags.message: This grant-moment event opened on 2026-03-30, but the 2026-08-16 snapshot includes later merits briefing and argument scheduling. The provisioned brief-in-opposition.txt also concatenates the February cert BIO (lines 1-260) with the corrected August respondent merits brief beginning at line 261, while documents.json represents the composite as one brief-in-opposition item. I encountered part of the appended brief while locating the boundary, but it revealed no outcome and I excluded it and all other post-grant material from the forecast.
